front.title: Attested Fence Receipts: Hardware-Rooted Evidence of Authority-Epoch Enforcement at Consequential Sinks

abstract.t: Revoking the authority of a delegated agent is not the same as proving that no consequential effect can still be committed under that authority. A revocation cut applied at one resource sink is not evidence of enforcement at another sink, and a software acknowledgement from a sink is only as trustworthy as the software that produced it. This document defines the Attested Fence Receipt (AFR), an Entity Attestation Token (EAT) profile emitted by the hardware-rooted Attesting Environment of a consequential sink after the sink has durably applied an authority-epoch fence. It further defines a verification procedure for individual receipts, a closure- evaluation procedure over a declared sink set that yields CLOSED, PARTIAL, FAILED, or UNKNOWN, and a hardware fence profile that binds the fence to measured state: an extend-only authority register, a monotonic counter, counter-gated derivation of per-epoch effect- attestation keys, and PCR-bound key release. The mechanism supplies the per-sink evidence that revocation-closure determinations require, and it is designed so that the absence of evidence can never be read as closure.
